name: Custom ROM Detection
description: Checks build properties (test-keys, ro.debuggable, ro.secure) and known custom ROM identifiers (LineageOS, PixelExperience, etc.).

evidenceUnits.title: Custom or debug build fingerprint
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Build tags, debugging and security properties, and maintained ROM identifiers
evidenceUnits.proposition: An app-visible build value matches a maintained custom-ROM or debug-build rule
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on property availability and the maintained identifier set
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: Build and property values are user-space observations that can be spoofed
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A custom or debug build is not equivalent to root or malicious tampering
